metadata.qualification: Diagnostic separation of larger public projection tiles and wider attention. Actual final-layer Q/K/V compared against an independent float64 block-softmax reference with the established FP16 operand and probability storage. 1 warmup and 3 native repeats; all 128 free-AR IDs compared with the qualified FP8 model. Nine teacher-forced logits diagnose any divergence. A candidate that changes free-AR IDs is not promoted; this is not a serving qualification.
